what: Native wall-clock Pallas MSM: arkworks stock vs our canonical schedules
why: Decide whether Mizu's MSM work transfers to o1js, whose prover runs these same crates natively (kimchi-napi) or in WASM (kimchi-wasm)
host: Apple Silicon Mac, 10 logical cores, shared machine
correctness: every arm asserted equal to arkworks' msm_bigint at every size

findings.glv_helps_within_our_path: 5.9% to 14.2% faster than our affine schedule, shrinking as size grows
findings.our_msm_does_not_parallelise: identical times at 1 and 10 threads; arkworks scales 4.5x at 2^16
findings.verdict: Do not port the MSM schedules to o1js. They would be a large regression.

reproduction: Re-run at 10 threads reproduced our arms within 0.3% (affine 691.1 ms, affine+glv 635.2 ms at 2^16). arkworks' 2^16 varied 61.5-82.4 ms across runs on this shared machine, so its advantage is quoted as a range, not a point. threads-10.txt holds the second run.
